MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 64

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 22

7. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 36

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
